rounded_shapes.description: Modules for creating rounded 3D shapes with smooth edges using minkowski operations

rounded_cube.description: Creates a cube or rectangular prism with rounded edges and corners
rounded_cube.usage: rounded_cube([20, 30, 40], 5); // Creates a 20x30x40 cube with 5mm rounded edges
rounded_cube.notes: Size too small for rounding radius will generate an error

rounded_cylinder.description: Creates a cylinder with rounded top and bottom edges
rounded_cylinder.usage: rounded_cylinder(50, 20, 3); // Creates a 50mm tall cylinder with 3mm rounded edges
rounded_cylinder.notes: Dimensions too small for rounding radius will generate an error

rounded_pyramid.description: Creates a pyramid with rounded base edges and apex
rounded_pyramid.usage: rounded_pyramid([30, 40], 25, 2); // Creates a pyramid with 30x40 base, 25mm height, 2mm rounding
rounded_pyramid.notes: Uses linear_extrude with scale=0 to create pyramid shape

rounded_cone.description: Creates a cone with rounded base edge
rounded_cone.usage: rounded_cone(15, 30, 2); // Creates a cone with 15mm base radius, 30mm height, 2mm rounding
rounded_cone.notes: Creates a cone with rounded bottom edge

gears_mechanical.description: Advanced gear generation system with involute tooth profiles for mechanical designs

gear.description: Generates a 2D involute gear profile that can be extruded into 3D
gear.usage: linear_extrude(height=10) gear(number_of_teeth=20, circular_pitch=200); // Creates a 20-tooth gear
gear.notes: Requires either circular_pitch or diametral_pitch. Uses involute tooth profile for smooth meshing

involute_gear_tooth.description: Internal module for generating a single involute gear tooth profile
involute_gear_tooth.usage: Used internally by gear() module, not typically called directly
involute_gear_tooth.notes: Creates precise involute curve for gear tooth geometry

test_gears.description: Test module that creates a simple gear layout for testing
test_gears.usage: test_gears(); // Creates test gears with different tooth counts
test_gears.notes: Demonstrates basic gear functionality with 51 and 17 tooth gears

demo_3d_gears.description: Creates 3D demonstration gears with various configurations

test_involute_curve.description: Visual test for involute curve generation
test_involute_curve.notes: Helps visualize the mathematical involute curve used in gears

patterns_textures.description: Modules for creating repeating patterns and surface textures

honeycomb.description: Creates a hexagonal honeycomb pattern for 2D extrusion
honeycomb.usage: linear_extrude(5) honeycomb(width=50, depth=40, cell_size=8); // Creates honeycomb pattern
honeycomb.notes: Uses circles with 6 facets to create hexagonal cells

knurling.description: Creates a knurled grip pattern on cylindrical surfaces
knurling.usage: knurling(radius=20, height=30); // Creates knurled pattern on cylinder
knurling.notes: Uses diamond-shaped cuts at 45-degree angles for grip texture

voronoi_cell.description: Creates simplified Voronoi cell patterns (basic implementation)
voronoi_cell.notes: Simplified implementation - full Voronoi requires complex algorithms

basic_3d_primitives.description: Enhanced 3D primitive shapes with additional features

chamfered_cube.description: Creates a cube with chamfered (beveled) edges
chamfered_cube.usage: chamfered_cube([20, 30, 40], 2); // Creates cube with 2mm chamfered edges
chamfered_cube.notes: Uses hull() operation to create beveled edges

tube.description: Creates a hollow cylinder (tube) by subtracting inner cylinder
tube.usage: tube(outer_radius=10, inner_radius=8, height=50); // Creates hollow tube
tube.notes: Inner cylinder is slightly taller to ensure clean subtraction

torus.description: Creates a torus (donut shape) using rotate_extrude
torus.notes: Major radius is center-to-center distance, minor is tube radius

prism.description: Creates an n-sided prism by extruding a polygon
prism.usage: prism(sides=6, radius=15, height=30); // Creates hexagonal prism
prism.notes: Uses circle with specified number of facets to create polygon base

slot.description: Creates a rounded rectangular slot for 2D extrusion
slot.usage: slot(length=30, width=10, height=5); // Creates rounded slot
slot.notes: Uses hull() of two circles to create rounded ends

helix.usage: helix(inner_radius=10, outer_radius=15, height=50); // Creates helical coil
helix.notes: Uses hull() of spheres to create smooth helical path

basic_2d_primitives.description: 2D primitive shapes for extrusion into 3D objects

fillet_2d.description: Creates a 2D fillet (rounded corner) for use in extrusions
fillet_2d.usage: linear_extrude(10) fillet_2d(radius=5); // Creates rounded corner extrusion
fillet_2d.notes: Creates quarter-circle fillet by default, customizable angle

chamfer_2d.description: Creates a 2D chamfer (beveled corner) for use in extrusions
chamfer_2d.usage: linear_extrude(10) chamfer_2d(size=5); // Creates beveled corner extrusion

rounded_rectangle.description: Creates a 2D rounded rectangle for extrusion
rounded_rectangle.notes: Uses hull() of four circles to create rounded corners

spiral.description: Creates a 2D spiral pattern for extrusion
spiral.usage: linear_extrude(2) spiral(inner_radius=5, outer_radius=20); // Creates spiral pattern
spiral.notes: Creates smooth spiral using hull() operations

fasteners_hardware.description: Modules for creating mechanical fasteners and hardware components

simple_thread.description: Creates simple screw thread pattern on cylindrical surfaces
simple_thread.usage: simple_thread(radius=5, pitch=2, height=20); // Creates screw threads
simple_thread.notes: Uses diamond-shaped cuts to simulate thread pattern

bearing.description: Creates a simple ball bearing with inner and outer races
bearing.usage: bearing(outer_radius=15, inner_radius=8, height=7); // Creates ball bearing
bearing.notes: Includes ball groove and multiple ball bearings

washer.description: Creates a simple flat washer by subtracting inner cylinder
washer.usage: washer(outer_radius=8, inner_radius=4, thickness=1); // Creates flat washer
washer.notes: Simple difference operation between two cylinders

countersunk_hole.description: Creates a countersunk hole for flat-head screws
countersunk_hole.notes: Combines straight hole with tapered countersink

bolt.description: Creates a complete bolt with head and threaded shaft
bolt.notes: Combines cylindrical head with threaded shaft

nut.description: Creates a hexagonal nut with internal threading
nut.usage: nut(outer_radius=8, inner_radius=4, height=5); // Creates hex nut
nut.notes: Hexagonal prism with threaded center hole

joints_mechanisms.description: Modules for creating mechanical joints and articulated mechanisms

dovetail_male.description: Creates the male part of a dovetail joint
dovetail_male.usage: dovetail_male(width=20, height=10, depth=15); // Creates male dovetail

dovetail_female.description: Creates the female part of a dovetail joint with clearance
dovetail_female.usage: dovetail_female(width=20, height=10, depth=15); // Creates female dovetail
dovetail_female.notes: Includes small clearance for proper fit

flexible_hinge.description: Creates a flexible hinge using alternating segments
flexible_hinge.usage: flexible_hinge(length=50, width=10, thickness=2); // Creates flexible hinge
flexible_hinge.notes: Alternating segments allow bending while maintaining strength

structural_elements.description: Modules for creating structural and architectural elements

lattice.description: Creates a 3D lattice structure with intersecting beams
lattice.notes: Creates grid pattern in X, Y, and Z directions

living_hinge.description: Creates a living hinge pattern for flexible connections
living_hinge.usage: living_hinge(length=100, width=20); // Creates flexible living hinge
living_hinge.notes: Uses alternating cut patterns to create flexibility

text_utilities.description: Utility modules for text and special applications

text_3d.notes: Wrapper around linear_extrude and text() for easy 3D text creation

spring_coil.description: Specialized modules for creating springs and coil structures

spring.description: Creates a helical spring using connected spheres
spring.usage: spring(radius=15, wire_radius=2, pitch=8, height=50); // Creates coil spring
spring.notes: Uses hull() of spheres to create smooth spring coils

gear_rack.description: Linear gear components for rack and pinion systems
Creates a linear gear rack with triangular teeth
gear_rack.usage: linear_extrude(10) gear_rack(length=100, tooth_count=20); // Creates gear rack
gear_rack.notes: Creates triangular teeth suitable for rack and pinion mechanisms

gridfinity_system.description: Complete Gridfinity modular storage system components

grid_block.description: Creates basic Gridfinity block with optional magnet and screw holes
grid_block.usage: grid_block(num_x=2, num_y=3, num_z=4); // Creates 2x3x4 Gridfinity block
grid_block.notes: Core building block for Gridfinity system with 42mm pitch

base_lid.description: Creates a lid for Gridfinity baseplates
base_lid.usage: base_lid(3, 2); // Creates lid for 3x2 Gridfinity base
base_lid.notes: Designed to fit on top of Gridfinity baseplates

weighted_baseplate.description: Creates a weighted baseplate with magnet and screw holes
weighted_baseplate.notes: Heavy-duty baseplate with integrated mounting features

frame_plain.description: Creates a plain frame for Gridfinity system
frame_plain.usage: frame_plain(2, 2, extra_down=2); // Creates 2x2 frame with extra depth
frame_plain.notes: Basic frame structure with customizable depth

pad_grid.description: Internal module for creating Gridfinity pad layouts
pad_grid.notes: Handles complex grid layouts including half-pitch arrangements

pad_halfsize.description: Internal module for half-size Gridfinity pads
pad_halfsize.notes: Creates half-size pads for complex grid arrangements

cylsq.description: Creates a square cylinder instead of round
cylsq.usage: cylsq(d=10, h=20); // Creates 10mm square cylinder, 20mm tall
cylsq.notes: Square cross-section cylinder, 'd' is side length not diagonal

cylsq2.usage: cylsq2(d1=10, d2=5, h=20); // Creates tapered square cylinder
cylsq2.notes: Square cylinder that tapers from d1 to d2 over height h

pad_oversize.description: Internal module for oversize Gridfinity pads with bevels
pad_oversize.notes: Creates pads with specific bevel geometry for Gridfinity compatibility

gridcopycorners.description: Internal module for copying objects to Gridfinity corner positions
gridcopycorners.usage: Used internally for magnet and screw hole placement
gridcopycorners.notes: Places objects at corner positions with optional box corner filtering

cornercopy.description: Internal module for copying to corner positions

gridcopy.description: Internal module for copying objects in Gridfinity grid pattern
gridcopy.usage: Used internally for Gridfinity grid operations

mathematical_functions.description: Mathematical utility functions used by gear system

pitch_circular2diameter.description: Converts circular pitch to diameter for given number of teeth
pitch_circular2diameter.notes: Used internally by gear calculation functions

pitch_diametral2diameter.description: Converts diametral pitch to diameter for given number of teeth

involute_intersect_angle.description: Calculates involute curve intersection angle for gear geometry
involute_intersect_angle.notes: Mathematical function for involute gear tooth profiles

polar_to_cartesian.description: Converts polar coordinates to cartesian coordinates
polar_to_cartesian.notes: Used for gear tooth coordinate calculations
